author: Kushal
problem: AtCoder Grand Contests are named AGC001, AGC002, ... in order, except that the number 042 was skipped. Read N (1 to 53) and print the name of the N-th contest with a three-digit number.
bug_description: Uses N > 42 instead of N >= 42, so the 42nd contest is named AGC042 instead of AGC043.

comments.accurate: Builds the name of the N-th AGC, skipping the retired number 42 and zero-padding to three digits
comments.wrong_behavior: Builds the name of the N-th AGC, shifting numbers after 42 up by one and zero-padding to three digits
comments.wrong_location: Skip check for 42 verified; check the zero-padding for two-digit contest numbers
